name: married-early-planner
facts:
Goal: maximize wealth at retirement, planning to age 92.
- Age 35, married filing jointly (finances pooled with spouse), retiring at 67.
- Combined gross income $190,000 a year; can save $25,000 a year.
- Will spend $90,000 a year in retirement.
- Balances: $150,000 traditional (pre-tax), $40,000 Roth, $60,000 taxable brokerage.
- Leave Social Security and pensions out of the plan entirely. No employer match.
- Happy with the assistant's default assumptions for everything else.
